title: Advanced Debugging and Performance Optimization
summary: Establish enterprise-grade debugging, determinism, profiling, quality monitoring, and production deployment strategies that integrate with Super Alita's SDD-first workflow and constitutional guardrails.
problem_statement:
As a platform engineer, I want reliable debugging tools for multi-agent workflows so that I can troubleshoot issues efficiently.
As a QA engineer, I want deterministic execution modes so that I can ensure reproducible testing across environments.
As a developer, I want sandboxed profiling of AI-generated code so that I can optimize performance safely.
Given the need for production readiness, when deploying multi-agent systems, then we must have comprehensive monitoring and alerting.

This epic codifies enterprise debugging, performance optimization, and deployment capabilities as first-class SDD assets, leveraging existing libraries and frameworks where possible while maintaining test-first development practices.

in: Multi-agent quest orchestration with parallelism, timeouts, strict context isolation, and graceful degradation modes.
Deterministic execution modes and snapshot/golden output tests for non-deterministic behavior.
Lightweight, sandboxed performance profiling of AI-generated code and surfacing of optimization hints.
Continuous quality monitoring config and alerting thresholds.
Production deployment manifests for intelligent routing, autoscaling, and observability.
out: Vendor-specific hosting automation beyond declarative manifests.

constraints: Adhere to .github/CONSTITUTION.md (Library-First, Test-First, Simplicity, Integration, Clarity, Counterfactual Justification).
All new code uses absolute imports under src.*; sandbox dynamic execution.
No credentials in-repo; all secrets via environment.
non_goals: Build full vendor control planes for deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Given an SDD spec, plan, and tasks, when validated, then constitutional score ≥ 0.75.
Given CI pipeline execution, when SDD artifacts are generated, then spec.json, plan.json, tasks.json, and validation.json are uploaded.
Given documentation requirements, when epic is complete, then README or docs index links to the epic page.
Given test-first principles, when implementing determinism utilities, then minimum 80% test coverage is achieved.
Given integration-first approach, when deploying components, then end-to-end validation tests pass.
Given library-first development, when adding new functionality, then existing solutions are researched and documented.
Given simplicity requirements, when creating utilities, then functions remain under 50 lines with clear single responsibilities.
Given clarity principles, when writing documentation, then all usage examples are provided with clear acceptance criteria.
Given counterfactual justification, when making architectural decisions, then alternative approaches are documented with reasoning.
testing_requirements: Unit tests with 80% minimum coverage for all new utilities
Integration tests for sandboxed profiler with real code execution
End-to-end tests for CI pipeline SDD validation
Snapshot tests for deterministic execution modes
Performance benchmark tests for profiling components
library_research: Evaluate existing Python profiling libraries (cProfile, py-spy, memory_profiler)
Compare deployment tools (Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Helm)
integration_testing_strategy: Test components within complete Super-Alita ecosystem
Validate sandbox execution with real AI-generated code
Test CI pipeline with actual SDD validation
End-to-end workflow testing from development to production

success_metrics.Reproducibility: deterministic test replay success rate ≥ 95% on CI runs.

success_metrics.Quality: no regressions across code quality and performance metrics over 2 releases.

success_metrics.Operability: mean triage time for multi-agent failures decreases ≥ 30%.

deliverables: Quest Mode orchestration test plan and configs.
Deterministic mode utilities and snapshot testing guidance.
AI code profiler integration for sandboxed runs.
Quality monitoring config and dashboards list.

constitutional_alignment.library_first: Shared utilities (determinism, profiler, debugging) provided under src/* to be reused by features.
constitutional_alignment.test_first: E2E SDD validation job and snapshot/golden tests ensure reproducibility and guardrails.
constitutional_alignment.simplicity: Lightweight, minimal wrappers and clear configs favored over heavy frameworks.
constitutional_alignment.integration: CI validation integrates with validate_deployment.py and SDD CLI; artifacts uploaded for review.
constitutional_alignment.clarity: Clear separation of spec, plan, tasks with explicit acceptance criteria and metrics.
constitutional_alignment.counterfactual_justification: Choices motivated against simpler alternatives (e.g., why sandboxed profiler vs raw exec; why deterministic params).

risks: Overly strict determinism causing provider mismatch.
CI time increase due to profiling and validation.
risk_mitigations: Make deterministic controls opt-in per job; cache installs; parallelize CI where safe.
